offers.name: Fit check
offers.summary: Free. About 2 minutes. Describe the work and get a written answer on fit. If it is a fit, Ryan follows up to schedule the paid Quick Scan.

offers.name: Quick Scan
offers.summary: Scheduled after a fit. Credited toward a build if you sign within 14 days.

offers.name: Build
offers.summary: Per workflow. Fixed quote after the Quick Scan. Half due at kickoff and half at launch.

offers.name: Run
offers.summary: Plus 10-20% of measured gain over an agreed baseline, capped at 1.5x the retainer. 3-month minimum.

tooling: Clients pay for tools, APIs and seats on their own accounts. Supergood does not resell or mark up software.
